hostSettingsSaveHint: Click Save to apply changes to this host.
agentSavePairFirst: Save the pairing before configuring this agent.
agentConfigUnavailable: Configuration unavailable. Check the connection, token and agent version.
agentConfigConflict: The agent configuration changed elsewhere. Your edits are kept; reopen settings after copying or discarding them.
agentConfigPartialSave: Primary settings were saved, but an agent could not be updated. Remaining edits are kept.
appearanceSaveHint: The theme applies immediately, in every browser.
agentIntro: This section pairs remote supervision agents with this dashboard. Each agent collects metrics from one machine and exposes them here without receiving the dashboard configuration. Each agent reuses the color and icon of the host it is linked to.
agentHint: Agents expose local supervision only. Configure the same DASHMON_SYNC_TOKEN on each agent and this instance. Only test trusted addresses: the token is sent to them.
configConflict: Configuration changed in another tab. Reload the page before retrying.
localHostRequired: The local host is always monitored.
agentHostEmpty: No host is defined yet. Create a host first so this agent can reuse its color and icon.
agentHostRequiredMessage: Select a host in Pairing, or create one under Dashboard → Hosts to reuse its color and icon. You can also save without a host: the tile keeps its default appearance.
agentUrlHint: Full address, for example https://agent.exemple.lan:8080. http:// is used when no scheme is given. Each agent has its own tab name.
agentTokenMissing: The main instance has no sync token.
agentUnauthorized: The agent rejected the sync token.
agentInvalidResponse: The response is not from a compatible agent.
agentUnreachable: Agent unreachable: check the address, network and TLS certificate.
importExportHint: Export the complete Dashmon configuration to a JSON file, or import one. The example adds a few fictional applications to discover Dashmon. An import or the example only applies after Save.
importReady: Configuration imported. Click Save to store it.
unsavedMessage: Changes will be lost if you close without saving.
saveError: Save failed. Check that the configuration file is writable.
saveNotPersisted: Deletion not saved: config.json still contains {names}. Another instance or tab may have overwritten the change.
monitorHelp: Monitoring dot. Green: the application is monitored and an outage counts as critical. Orange: monitored, non-critical. Grey: not monitored. Click the dot to change.
choosePng: Choose or upload a PNG image
deleteDashboardConfirm: Delete this dashboard? Its categories will be moved to the first dashboard.
supervisionEmpty: No host is being monitored. Open Settings → Supervision → Local to configure monitoring.
supervisionError: Measurements are not available right now.
aptUpdatesErrorUnavailable: Details unavailable for this older report.
aptUpdatesHint: Local host: apt-updates.sh writes a report after each scheduled update.
aptUpdatesHelp: Install the weekly APT task: see the guide.
opencodeStale: Old report: check the cron job
opencodeNoModel: No model used in this period.
opencodeHelp: Schedule the OpenCode statistics script under your user: see the guide. The card appears with the first report.
claudeHelp: Schedule the Claude Code statistics script under your user: see the guide. The card appears with the first report.
smartHelpIntro: Install the SMART script and schedule it: see the installation guide.
wireguardHelpIntro: data/wireguard.dump must be regenerated on the host. Install the script and schedule its execution: see the installation guide.
hostLocalHint: Path mounted inside the container to read the host disk (root by default).
resetUsageConfirmMessage: The usage counters of every application start again from zero, and so does the “most used” sorting. This cannot be undone.
preferencesSaveHint: Saved immediately. The language applies to every browser; the other preferences only to this one.
introDashboards: Each dashboard is a tab of the top bar. A category belongs to one dashboard, where it is shown with its applications.
introCategories: Categories group the applications. Choose the dashboard, icon and color of each; drag a row to change the order.
introHosts: Hosts are the machines that run your applications. Their icon and color are used when grouping by host and on the supervision cards.
introWebLinks: Web links are shown in the banner under the toolbar. A counter can add GitHub stars, Docker Hub pulls or YouTube subscribers.
welcomeText: Your dashboard is empty. Add your applications to reach them in one click and see whether they respond, or load an example to see what a filled dashboard looks like.
demoReady: Example added: nine fictional applications on three machines. Click Save to keep it; delete them like any other application.
